description: List, inspect, update, mutate, delete, or retry scheduled, queued, and published social media posts stored in Nuntior Cloud — including live real-time YouTube video/Short title and hashtag/tag updates via YouTube Data API v3 (`PUT /youtube/v3/videos?part=snippet`) while keeping the existing description 100% intact unless `content` is explicitly changed, and custom YouTube thumbnail updates via `POST /upload/youtube/v3/thumbnails/set` (`thumbnailMediaAssetId` / `thumbnailUrl`) that do not rewrite title, description, or tags. Also tracks 72h hook iteration metadata (`rewriteCount`, `hookHistory`, `lastViewCount`, `iterationStatus`, `lessonsLearned`).

action.description: Post management operation: 'list' posts (optionally filtered by status), 'get' a single post by `postId` or `externalPostId` (with live YouTube view/like/comment counts and age in hours), 'update' / 'mutate' post content, YouTube title/tags, YouTube custom thumbnail, or schedule time, 'delete' a post, or 'retry_failed' to re-dispatch failed deliveries.

content.description: Updated post text content or video description when executing `action: 'update'` or `'mutate'` (omit to keep the existing YouTube description 100% intact).

externalPostId.description: Optional native platform video/post ID (e.g. YouTube `videoId`) to inspect or update directly on the platform even if originally uploaded outside Nuntior.

hookStyle.description: Optional hook rotation label ('opinion', 'data', 'question') tracked in `hookHistory` (with `rewriteCount` incremented automatically).

lesson.description: Optional performance lesson note saved on the post when closing an iteration loop.

postId.description: Unique post identifier (`post_...`). Required when `action` is 'get', 'update', 'mutate', or 'delete' unless `externalPostId` is provided.

preserveDescription.description: Keep the original description untouched when updating a published video's title/tags (default `true` when `title` is provided without `content`).

profileId.description: Brand profile identifier (`prof_...`) used to scope the post query or mutation.

scheduledFor.description: Updated ISO-8601 publication timestamp when rescheduling a post via `action: 'update'`.

statusFilter.description: Optional status filter when listing posts (e.g. 'published', 'scheduled', 'queued', 'failed', 'draft').

tags.description: Updated hashtags/tags for the post or video.

thumbnailMediaAssetId.description: Nuntior image media asset (`med_...`) to set as the custom thumbnail on a published YouTube video via `POST /upload/youtube/v3/thumbnails/set`. Preferred over `thumbnailUrl`. Does not call `videos.update` and does not alter title, description, or tags unless those fields are also passed. Requires a connected YouTube channel with upload scope. Channel must be verified for custom thumbnails.

thumbnailUrl.description: Public image URL (JPEG/PNG/GIF/BMP/WebP) to set as the custom thumbnail on a published YouTube video via `thumbnails.set`. Prefer `thumbnailMediaAssetId` when the file is already in Nuntior `/media`. Same no-snippet-rewrite contract as `thumbnailMediaAssetId`.

title.description: Updated video/post title (e.g., for YouTube Shorts title & hook iteration while keeping the description intact).

name: posts_manage
title: Manage Scheduled & Published Social Posts
